sentences.text: Today we will talk about a beautiful country in Europe.
This country is called Belgium.
Belgium is a small but very interesting country.
Listen carefully and try to understand.
I will speak slowly.
Let's begin.
Where is Belgium?
Belgium is a small country in Western Europe.
It is between France, Germany and the Netherlands.
The capital city of Belgium is Brussels.
Brussels is a very important city.
It is not only the capital of Belgium,
but also the capital of the European Union.
This means that many important leaders and politicians
from different countries go to Brussels for meetings.
Belgium has many borders with other countries,
so people can easily travel to France, Germany and the Netherlands.
Belgium is a small country,
but it has a lot of history and many things to see.
What is Belgium famous for?
Belgium is famous for many things.
One of the most famous things is chocolate.
Belgian chocolate is considered the best in the world.
It is sweet and rich,
and people from all over the world visit Belgium to taste it.
Belgium also has many famous chocolate factories.
You can take tours in some of these factories
and see how the chocolate is made.
Another thing Belgium is famous for is waffles.
Belgian waffles are soft and sweet.
You can eat them with different toppings,
like chocolate, cream or fruit.
They are a very popular snack
and you can find waffles in many places in Belgium.
People also eat waffles for breakfast or as a dessert.
Belgium is also known for its beautiful cities and old buildings.
Brussels has a famous square called the Grand Place.
The Grand Place is very big
and it is surrounded by beautiful old buildings
with golden decorations.
It is a very popular place for tourists.
Another famous city in Belgium is Bruges.
Bruges is a small beautiful city with canals and old houses.
Many people say that Bruges looks like a fairy tale.
You can take boat rides through the canals
or just walk around the city and enjoy the beautiful views.
Food in Belgium
The food in Belgium is very tasty.
People in Belgium eat a lot of potatoes.
One famous dish in Belgium is called frites or french fries.
Frites are very popular and you can find them in almost every city.
People eat fries with many different sauces,
like mayonnaise or ketchup.
Some people also like to put a little bit of salt on their fries.
Belgium is also famous for its beer.
Belgian beer is known all over the world.
There are many different types of beer in Belgium
and each type has a special taste.
People in Belgium drink beer in many different places
and it is a big part of their culture.
There are also beer festivals in Belgium
where you can try many different kinds of beer.
Another famous Belgian dish is called Stu Fles,
which is a type of beef stew.
It is made with beef, onions and beer.
It is very tasty and often served with fried eights.
People in Belgium also eat many delicious desserts.
One popular dessert is called speculus.
It is a type of spiced cookie and it is very sweet.
Another popular dessert is Belgian pralines.
These are chocolates filled with cream or caramel.
They are perfect for anyone who loves chocolate,
culture and people.
People in Belgium speak different languages.
The main languages are Dutch, French and German.
In the north of Belgium, people speak Dutch,
which is also called Flemish.
In the south, people speak French.
There is a small part of Belgium where people speak German.
Many people in Belgium also speak English,
especially in big cities like Brussels and Antwerp.
Belgium is a country with many traditions.
One famous tradition is called carnival.
The carnival of bench is one of the most famous festivals in Belgium.
It happens every year before Easter.
People wear colorful costumes and masks
and they dance and sing in the streets.
It is a very fun time for everyone
and people from all over the world visit Belgium to see the carnival.
Nature and animals.
Belgium has many beautiful parks, forests and nature areas.
One famous area in Belgium is called the Ardennes.
The Ardennes is a large forest with many hills and rivers.
It is a great place for hiking, biking and exploring nature.
Many people go to the Ardennes to relax and enjoy the fresh air.
Belgium is also home to many different animals.
In the forests, you can find animals like deer, foxes and wild boars.
Belgium has many birds too, and you can see them in the forests and parks.
There are also many small animals like rabbits and squirrels.
Belgium has many lakes and rivers.
The largest lake in Belgium is Lake Genval,
which is a popular place to relax and have a picnic.
People in Belgium like to go fishing in the lakes and rivers
and some people even enjoy ice fishing during the winter.
Conclusion
Belgium is a beautiful country with amazing food, history and nature.
It has friendly people and many interesting places to visit.
If you ever have the chance, you should visit Belgium to see its beautiful cities,
try the famous chocolate and waffles and enjoy the culture and nature.
Would you like to visit Belgium one day?
